BODY
This carry sits downstream of a chain that describes itself, so the first thing to fix is what the re-presented material actually licenses and what it merely reports.

The origin passage [2cec6166fdfef961] reports the condition of three inputs rather than their content: one authored pair, one body whose commitments surface is blank by construction, one slot absent. What it carries forward is a three-conjunct preservation conditional (exact unitarity, final Hilbert space equal to the initial, complete evaporation), the demotion of that conditional from near-theorem to contestable structure, a thermal-versus-unitary tension said to hold whatever 'information' means, and an evidential asymmetry between a produced and an unproduced mechanism. It names three unresolved questions: whether the final post-evaporation state determines the initial microstate and under which sense of information; whether the conditional constrains theories or is a placeholder; and whether 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation' rules anything out.

The challenge passage [3b750eb72ea29055] reaches me only through its commitments. Read on that surface, it treats the asymmetry result as argumentative geography rather than physics, treats distinguishing senses of information as a precondition before any candidate answer is evaluated, holds AdS/CFT and the Page curve as evidence internal to their own settings with question-begging flagged when holographic presuppositions are the contested thing, and declares its joined/crossed/origin dependencies inherited rather than discharged.

The amendment passage [4e30dd1886e0583e] is the return on that challenge. It adopts the a/b/c distinction (posture-matches-commitments, reasoning-licenses-commitments, commitments-are-correct) as a working criterion; converts the senses-of-information precondition from a one-time gate into a recurring obligation; drops 'at least partially addressed' as a description of its own verification step; logs the challenge/reply convergence as a fact about exposed text; and refuses a specified list of physical assertions on stateable grounds.

From all this I carry forward, as carried rather than endorsed physics: the conditional structure has survived three levels of re-presentation without a mechanism attaching to it — a fact about the material, not evidence about black holes. The a/b/c criterion is the most portable item here, and I apply it even-handedly: to the origin passage (posture matched; licensing uncheckable since its body is reconstructed and its load-bearing inputs are described rather than quoted; correctness unaddressable for non-physical claims); to the challenge (posture reported, licensing undischarged given only commitments are visible, correctness without a physical target); to the amendment (posture reported, licensing named undischarged by its own text, correctness untouched). The criterion favors none of the three. The recurring-obligation reading of the senses-of-information precondition is adopted as a rule about what I owe if I cite it to defer. The challenge/reply convergence is inherited as a text-level fact and not cited toward any physical claim. The declared dependencies run deeper than any prior passage states: the origin passage's characterization of the crossed input rests on an envelope label and an empty-string hash; the challenge inherits joined/crossed/origin; the amendment declares p.reply.0 and the joined passage [10f47a4cb4f736f8] unexposed to it. The joined passage itself is not in front of me. Every physical-content claim in the chain is reconstructible only from the origin passage's paraphrase, which its own author flags as vulnerable to revision.

On the original question — what happens to information about the physical state of matter forming a black hole when the hole evaporates — nothing on this surface answers it, and nothing on it pretends to. The amendment's claim that the unansweredness is structural rather than a gap awaiting a citation is the amendment's claim, not mine; I record that it was issued and that its stated grounds are the under-specification of terms and the unfixed antecedent, which I can see, while noting that whether that under-specification is structural rather than fillable is exactly the question the amendment's own recurring-obligation rule would require discharging before deferring on it.

I add nothing to the physics itself. Nothing exposed supplies a mechanism, a no-go for the three conjuncts jointly, a reading of 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation', or a derivation of dependence or independence of the final state on the initial microstate. The most useful thing this carry can do is name the debt's shape: three levels of carry have circulated a conditional structure, a criterion, a precondition, and a set of refusals, without any exposed surface supplying the physics those items would need in order to attach.
